notes.title: My new game is OUT! Automation, Colony Building, Defense
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2349040/Dinky_Guardians/
[previewyoutube=dVbU7jO67A8;full][/previewyoutube]
⬆️ Clone your first [b]🐷Dinky[/b], give them 👉orders to help you, Research 🦾[b]Automation Machines,[/b] Defend your Colony from the 👿Zumbys, Build a 🚀[b]Rocket,[/b] colonize other 🌍Planets and set up supply chains between them! Play [u]Solo👤[/u] or [u]Co-op👥 [/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43477750/d49245dbc460be2c1e93bb3df2daf20700599fb8.gif[/img]

[h2]The Ultimate Goal[/h2]
Repopulate the [b]entire galaxy[/b] with Dinkys and fully [b]automate everything[/b] with Machines so that the Dinkys can live their lives in peace!


Play [u]solo[/u] or with up to [u]4 friends[/u] in this fun Colony-Building, Automation, Defense adventure

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2349040/Dinky_Guardians/


Interested in the behind the scenes? Watch my devlogs to see how the game came to be!
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLzDRvYVwl53ueGEHkpRtO9e-7QZDHNcfa


[b]Thanks and I hope you like the game![/b]
- Hugo (Code Monkey, Endless Loop Studios)

notes.title: My next game, Total World Liberation, wishlist now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2177230/Total_World_Liberation/
[previewyoutube=08N85yARCMo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h2]They have taken over everything, it's up to you to LIBERATE the entire world![/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/4799d3bd407cd877caa1969ba0b1351fd3a0482d.gif[/img]

* Find other [b]Survivors [/b]and bring them with you.
* [b]Build [/b]your base with a Workshop, Generator, Houses and plenty of [b]Defenses and Traps![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/dd7cbbeb3af23274fd65c6ead45e5f4904cf3f8b.gif[/img]

* Split up into [b]multiple teams[/b] and explore different areas, don't forget to bring [b]enough ammo[/b] when you leave your base!
* Set up outposts to [b]gather resources [/b]in far away lands and Transport them back to your base through[b] Automated machines,[/b] ensure the Zombies don't destroy your logistics!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/c0c59f2340ef79f735d54daf64ea3e2d6674133c.gif[/img]

* [b]Craft items[/b], armor, weapons and lots of ammo, build [b]Drones[/b] to help you [b]Gather, Craft and Patrol[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/0603411db532e715ad234a9baeffaba910f22074.gif[/img]

* Explore a large [b]persistent open world[/b], with no loading or mission instances, everything happens in the world.
* Turn-Based so you can take your time to think and come up with the [b]perfect Strategy[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/a141b0ffa70b7acb86963690902db36a487761f9.gif[/img]

* [b]Ambush[/b] Zombies and take them all out without suffering casualties
* Be careful when exploring at [b]night[/b], and be even more careful so you don't attract a [b]massive horde![/b]

Start just with [b]one[/b] Survivor and [b]Liberate the entire World![/b]


[h2]Add to your Wishlist now! Q3 2023[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/877249ba8ddffa0abe2dc4dca3ce1b5496e8c6a2.gif[/img]

[b]And follow the Development on YouTube @CodeMonkeyUnity[/b]

Interested in the behind the scenes? Watch this video!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6DGDWfPdn3w

Thanks for watching!
- Hugo (Code Monkey, Endless Loop Studios)

notes.title: Sandbox Mode! - v1.08 - 23/06/2016
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/15115516/af0ed55ab68f02e87892032d0aa993e2f8f1eefe.jpg[/img]
The most requested feature, [b]Sandbox mode,[/b] is now live!

You can choose the options and it will create a randomly generated map according to your specifications. Pick the number of islands, the speed of the Blueprints, how easy or hard is it to get gold, how needy your Workers are, etc.

Coming soon, [b]Workshop Sandbox templates.[/b] You will be able to set up your own goods types, their recipes, their contracts and then play around with them in a Sandbox scenario!

-

v1.08 - 23/06/2016

* Sandbox mode!

* Added Tutorial Arrow pointing to New Route Goods button
* Tutorial Keys now more clear, Alpha3 -> 3
* Fixed objective background size
* Fixed key center on main while in Editor
* Fixed Tutorial bug when completing Tier 2 Research before route
* Fixed Assistant Window on top of New Route button
* Error message Insufficient resources now mentions Construction
* Error message when dragging routes between islands now mentions Ships
